input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: redteam campaigns on three recently changed ventures

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 says fix every open entry first, but all 9 open entries are control-plane workflow edits that already have open owner-gated PRs; the open list has no marker for "PR open, waiting on owner", so each run re-reads and re-checks them.
`targets --probe 20` with no --under printed nothing for the files I grepped for (it lists a sample); `--under <venture dir>` was needed to probe a chosen file.

deviations.why: Step 0 (fix open entries) skipped: every entry needs a control-plane workflow edit that already has an open PR awaiting owner approval; a duplicate PR would add noise.
deviations.did: Listed the existing PRs in the PR body and went to seeding.
deviations.result: Run time went to 24 mutants and 6 guards instead.

deviations.why: Step 4b (leave an automated guard) not done: the six escapes were unrelated single-boundary gaps in three products, not a class one lint could catch, and each new test now runs in ventures-tests on every PR.
deviations.did: Added the tests to the existing suites only.

notes: Campaigns: guard.mjs 5/8, verify.mjs 7/8, engine.mjs 6/8; all 6 escapes triaged gap, rerun caught_after_fix true for all. Real-bug hunt over llm-spend-guard proxy.mjs/providers.mjs/guard.mjs and webhook-relay verify.mjs (14 schemes) found nothing reproducible. Verification: run_venture_tests.py on the 3 slugs: 3 suites, 0 failed. Float finding: 400 x (3000 tok * $75/M) sums to 89.99999999999963 in doubles, so the 1e-12 alert tolerance is load-bearing.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
